subject: MAP kickoff — proposed plan, timeline options, and risk owners
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Miller <sasha.miller@monarchhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP kickoff draft and timeline options

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. I wanted to send a short recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached for your review so we can turn the conversation into a concrete timeline. Attached: MAP_v1_Monarch.xlsx (milestones + owners) and a light SOW-draft.pdf for legal to review.

High-level recommended milestones (first pass):
- 1) Pilot scope confirmation (Monarch: Product; Redwood: Solutions) — target: 1 week
- 2) Security & compliance review (Monarch: IT Security) — target: 2–3 weeks
- 3) SOW redlines + procurement (Monarch: Procurement; Redwood: Legal) — target: 2 weeks
- 4) Pilot provisioning + test data (Redwood infra + Monarch eng) — target: 1 week
- 5) Pilot go-live and evaluation (Joint) — target: 2 weeks

Timeline options (tradeoffs):
- Option A — Aggressive: Contracting complete by 2026-06-30; pilot start week of 2026-07-06 (best for quicker ROI, requires fast legal/procurement turnaround)
- Option B — Conservative: Contracting complete by 2026-07-15; pilot start week of 2026-07-27 (adds buffer for security evidence and PO cycles)

Key dependencies / risks to call out:
- SOC 2 artifact access & timeline (Monarch security needs to confirm which artifacts suffice)
- SOW redline turnarounds and whether Monarch requires further procurement approvals
- Data residency confirmation for test data (if any regional constraints)
- Availability of Monarch platform engineers for provisioning during the proposed windows

Ask from you: please confirm the primary stakeholders we should include on the MAP for each milestone (security, procurement, platform eng), and indicate which timeline option you prefer (A or B) or propose alternate dates. If you prefer, we can own SOW consolidation and share a single redline-based document for legal to speed the loop.

Next steps from our side once we have stakeholder list & preferred timeline: we’ll update MAP_v1, add explicit owners and dates, and share a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

On Mon, May 11, 2026 at 2:05 PM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sasha —
> 
> Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. I wanted to send a short recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached for your review so we can turn the conversation into a concrete timeline. Attached: MAP_v1_Monarch.xlsx (milestones + owners) and a light SOW-draft.pdf for legal to review.

Thanks, Ava — this is helpful. Quick responses and notes from the Monarch side:

Confirmed stakeholders (please add to the MAP):
- Sarah Lee (IT Security) — sarah.lee@monarchhealth.com
- Tom Nguyen (Platform Engineering) — tom.nguyen@monarchhealth.com
- Procurement team (procurement@monarchhealth.com) — primary procurement lead will be looping in shortly

Timeline preference: aiming for Option B-ish but would like to push pilot target to around 2026-07-10 for our internal alignment; contracting target realistically looks like mid-July (around 2026-07-20) given legal / procurement cycles.

Notes on risks:
- Legal review tends to be the longest pole; procurement needs our SOW in final form to issue PO. If Redwood can produce a consolidated SOW with tracked redlines, that will speed review.
- Security would like to run a short artefact review — Sarah will reach out with a list (likely SOC 2 summary + encryption details).

I’ll introduce Sarah and procurement lead on the next thread to make stakeholder confirmation easier. For now, please add the confirmed names to the MAP and update Option B dates to reflect the June->July shift I mentioned.

Thanks,
Sasha Miller
Head of Product Partnerships
Monarch Health
Sasha.Miller@monarchhealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Recap + MAP kickoff draft and timeline options

Thanks Sasha — adding the stakeholders now. I updated the attached MAP with explicit owners and two timeline scenarios that match what you suggested (Option B adjusted). Highlights of MAP_v1 updates:

- Milestone owners: Security -> Sarah Lee (Monarch), Procurement -> procurement@monarchhealth.com, Platform provisioning -> Tom Nguyen (Monarch) / Redwood infra (Jonas)
- Proposed contracting window: 2026-07-08 to 2026-07-22 (this leaves a couple of buffer days for signatures/PO issuance)
- Pilot target start: week of 2026-07-27
- Dependencies: legal SOW turnaround (Redwood to produce consolidated redline version by 2026-05-18 if Monarch confirms), security artefact list from Sarah by 2026-05-20

Ask from Monarch: can procurement confirm when they typically run POs after SOW sign-off (days)? That will help us lock the contracting window. Also, Sarah — if you can share the specific SOC 2 artefacts required, Redwood can pre-stage evidence to speed the review.

HubSpot: I pushed these milestones into DEAL-2026-0431 so our CS and renewals teams have visibility.

-Karthik

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. Recap of the agreed kickoff plan and next concrete asks so we’re all aligned: 

Agreed plan (high level):
- Redwood to produce consolidated SOW redline by 2026-05-18 (Ava / Redwood Legal)
- Sarah (Monarch IT Security) to send artefact list by 2026-05-20
- Procurement to confirm PO cadence / any internal approval gates by 2026-05-21
- Target contracting window: 2026-07-08 -> 2026-07-22
- Target pilot start: week of 2026-07-27

Immediate asks for Monarch (action items):
- Confirm final stakeholder list on MAP (security, procurement, platform eng) — reply-all OK
- Confirm preferred contracting cadence (procurement) so we can set the contracting buffer
- Sarah: publish artefact list to this thread (or share through the link below)

What Redwood will do next:
- Share updated MAP (see attached MAP_v1_Monarch.xlsx) with owners and dates; produce consolidated SOW redline by 2026-05-18
- Create a DocuSign room and push SOW once redlines are agreed (link below)
- Stand up a short tech kickoff for platform engineers when procurement confirms PO timeline (Jonas will handle provisioning)

Links / attachments: MAP_v1_Monarch.xlsx (attached), SOW-draft.pdf (attached), DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/rooms/monarch-MAP-2026, HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-2026-0431

Thanks — excited to move forward.
